newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Deutsche Bank buys Australia's Axiom.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank buys Australia's Axiom.

text.p: The New South Wales state government said on Friday that it would sell the Axiom funds management business to Deutsche Bank Group for A$240 million.
"The government found the Deutsche Bank Group's proposal was of the greatest long-term benefit to taxpayers and fund members, despite not offering the highest price received," it said.

"We expect the Deutsche Bank Group's experience in managing international assets will enhance returns and so reduce the cost to taxpayers of accumulated unfunded liabilities," state treasurer Michael egan said.
Axiom has about A$18 billion of funds under management.
The selection of Deutsche Bank as preferred tenderer followed a bidding contest which was believed to have been closely fought with National Australia Bank Ltd.

The government said the agreement by Deutsche to buy Axiom included a commitment to move some of its asset management business currently conducted in London to Sydney and to transfer marketing resources to Australian and New Zealand clients from Singapore.
It said management of Axiom's international assets would be undertaken offshore by Morgan Grenfell Asset Management.
Deutsche Australia had signed a binding letter of intent for a Deutsche Bank Group unit to buy Axiom, with the purchase price to be paid immediately upon completion.
The purchase had foreign investment review board approval.
The government said the terms of its agreement included a five year investment management contract and termination in the event of unsatisfactory investment performance by Axiom.
The German-owned bank would also implement a business plan to increase the size of Axiom, which manages the pension funds of the state's public servants.

Egan said the government had received several high quality bids, but did not elaborate. Recent newspaper articles said the short-listed bidders included NAB, Macquarie Bank Ltd, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, and the AMP Society.
